text:
58세 남성 환자, acute decompensated cirrhosis with hepatic encephalopathy로 입원함.

BP 95/60 mmHg, HR 112 bpm, RR 20 breaths/min, BT 36.5°C, SpO2 92% on room air.

Moderate jaundice 확인됨. 

환자 drowsy 상태 유지함.

Lactulose 30 mL PO q8h 투여함.

Nasal cannula at 2 L/min 적용함.

Strict fluid balance monitoring 유지함.

Hepatology team notify함.
